description: This PHP class 'PendingLeaveRequestSummary' is part of the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the Dashboard DTO for Action Summary. It encapsulates logic to summarize pending leave requests for approval, leveraging leave request search filter parameters and services.

classes.name: PendingLeaveRequestSummary
classes.description: A class representing a summary of pending leave requests to approve, including methods to retrieve group information and count of pending items.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with accessible employee numbers and prepares leave request search filter parameters.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID for this summary category, fixed value of 1.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group label 'Leave Requests To Approve'.

methods.name: getPendingActionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of pending leave requests awaiting approval, utilizing the leave request service and DAO.
